scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:portless && pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm run setup:localization
scripts.setup:portless: portless proxy start --no-tls && portless alias projecthelios 5173
scripts.setup:backend: uv sync --project apps/backend && pnpm run backend:migrate
scripts.test:localization: uv run --locked --project apps/localization pytest -c apps/localization/pyproject.toml apps/localization/tests
scripts.lint:localization: uv run --locked --project apps/localization ruff check apps/localization
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project apps/backend python apps/backend/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:localization
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project apps/backend ruff check apps/backend
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:backend && pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:localization
scripts.dev:control-worker: uv run --project apps/backend python apps/backend/manage.py control_worker
scripts.solo:postgres: uv run --locked --project apps/backend python scripts/dev.py --service postgres
scripts.solo:redis: uv run --locked --project apps/backend python scripts/dev.py --service redis
scripts.solo:backend: uv run --locked --project apps/backend python scripts/dev.py --service backend
scripts.solo:control: uv run --locked --project apps/backend python scripts/dev.py --service control
scripts.solo:frontend: uv run --locked --project apps/backend python scripts/dev.py --service frontend
scripts.solo:localization: uv run --locked --project apps/backend python scripts/dev.py --service localization
